description: NR Electric RCS-941 distance zones (zones 1-3 and the reverse zone) as an RCS-941 setting sheet prints them. Catalog-only, verified subset: the CT / VT ratings, the phase-phase element reach (Z_PPn) at the positive-sequence reach angle (phi1_Reach), the per-loop element enables (En_ZPPn / En_ZPGn), the timers, the explicitly enabled phase-earth quadrilateral resistive reach (Rn_Quad while En_ZPGn_Quad = 1), K0 and the line data. Not interpreted: a zone in-service state (not stated per zone), the forward zones' direction (not stated), the characteristic (not named), the impedance basis, the phase-earth mho reach and angle, and any phase-earth geometry.
interpretation_notes: The zones are the sheet's zone 1, 2, 3 parameter groups (Z_PPn / Z_PGn, t_*, En_ZPPn / En_ZPGn) and the reverse zone (Z_Rev, t_Rev, En_ZPP_Rev / En_ZPG_Rev).

Each zone's phase-phase and phase-earth elements are enabled separately (mapped as Phase-Phase Faults / Earth Faults). The sheet states no single zone in-service switch, so the zone's status is not derived from them (Missing).
The forward zones' direction is not a setting on the sheet and is not assumed. The reverse zone's direction follows from its identity in the parameter names (an assumption to confirm).

The phase-phase reach is Z_PPn at the positive-sequence reach angle phi1_Reach. The sheet does not name the characteristic, so none is assumed; the phase-earth reach (Z_PGn) and its geometry are preserved with the zone, not interpreted. The impedance basis is not stated and is not assumed.
U1n / U2n are printed as the VT's rated primary (kV) and secondary (V) values as the relay states them (phase-to-neutral on this sheet); they are kept as printed.

zone_preserved.reason: The phase-earth element's reach. Its reach angle and characteristic are not established, so it is not used as the Earth Reach; preserved as stated.
The phase-earth quadrilateral enable of this zone (1 = on). It gates the zone's Earth Resistive Reach; the quadrilateral's geometry itself is not represented.

mappings.note: I1n: the CT's rated primary current.
I2n: the CT's rated secondary current.
U1n: the VT's rated primary voltage as printed (kV, phase-to-neutral on this sheet), converted to volts.
U2n: the VT's rated secondary voltage as printed (phase-to-neutral on this sheet).
Line length as printed; the sheet prints no unit.
R1L / X1L read as the line's positive-sequence impedance ('1' / '0' and 'L' in the sheet's own names; no unit printed, ohms assumed).
R0L / X0L read as the line's zero-sequence impedance ('1' / '0' and 'L' in the sheet's own names; no unit printed, ohms assumed).
The zone's phase-phase element enable (En_ZPPn / En_ZPP_Rev, 1 = on).
The zone's phase-earth element enable (En_ZPGn / En_ZPG_Rev, 1 = on).
This is the relay's reverse zone (Z_Rev, t_Rev, En_ZPP_Rev / En_ZPG_Rev): the direction follows from the zone's identity in the sheet's parameter names, not from a direction setting. Confirm.
mappings.unresolved_note: the reverse zone's reach / timer was not found

mappings.note: The phase-phase element's reach (Z_PPn) at the positive-sequence reach angle (phi1_Reach).
The reverse zone's reach (Z_Rev) at the positive-sequence reach angle (phi1_Reach).

requires.off_note: The zone's phase-earth quadrilateral is disabled (En_ZPGn_Quad = 0): Rn_Quad is not in use; none is assumed.
requires.missing_note: the zone's phase-earth quadrilateral enable was not found, so Rn_Quad is not established as in use

mappings.note: The phase-earth quadrilateral's resistive reach (Rn_Quad), read only while the zone's phase-earth quadrilateral is enabled. Not drawn by the phase-phase engine.
Zone 1's delay (one setting for both loops).
K0, the relay-wide zero-sequence compensation factor, read as the K0 magnitude; the sheet states no angle and its exact definition is not stated. Not used by the engine.
